name: 晶石蜗
habitatEn: Evolves from Kuangjingchong at Lv.40 after mining 4 times
evolution: 矿晶虫 → 晶石蜗 Lv.40 → 钻石蜗
description: 在资源丰富的矿洞中能遇见的罕见蜗类，周身的矿石与斑纹会因摄入矿物类型的不同，而呈现出不同的色彩。进食时，它会直接吞下成块矿石，并通过特殊的消化结构，将其转化并沉积为自身躯体的一部分。
descriptionEn: A rare snail that can be encountered in resource-rich mines. The ores and markings all over its body take on different colors depending on the type of minerals it ingests. When feeding, it swallows chunks of ore directly and, through a special digestive structure, converts and deposits them as part of its own body.
